Backup & Restore is an Ad-Free Forever benefit. It saves group ringtone settings without putting contact details in the backup file.

Create a .grs backup for the selected contact source. The file stores group names, the first readable custom ringtone found in each group, readable default tones, and the audio files needed to restore them. It does not store contact names, numbers, or group membership.
Please keep the app open while your .grs file is being saved.
Please keep the app open while group ringtones are restored.
Ready to export or restore a backup.

Backup & Restore is designed to protect your contacts. A .grs file does not include contact names, phone numbers, or group membership. It stores only group names and the ringtone chosen for each group, plus the ringtone audio files and any readable default tones. If contacts in the same group use different ringtones, only the first readable custom ringtone found for that group is backed up. Restore imports those tones, restores default tones when permission is granted, then applies each saved group ringtone to contacts currently in matching groups on the selected source.
Select one contact source before exporting or restoring a backup.
